description:
## Why

Subset of PKIX-l63j epic. Builds on PKIX-l63j.1 (BMPString transcoding) to extend DN normalization to canonical-equivalence: precomposed vs decomposed Unicode forms, case-fold non-Latin scripts, full RFC 4518 §1 prep.

## What

1. Add `unicode-normalization` crate dep (no_std-capable) for NFKC.
2. Use Unicode `char::to_lowercase()` (already in core) for case folding non-ASCII.
3. Implement RFC 4518 §1 6-step prep: transcode (covered by PKIX-l63j.1), map (case-fold + control-strip), normalize (NFKC), prohibit, bidi check, insignificant-character (whitespace collapse already done).
4. Tests: precomposed 'café' (U+00E9) compares equal to decomposed 'café' (U+0065 U+0301).

## Acceptance

- See parent PKIX-l63j acceptance.

## Depends on

PKIX-l63j.1.
title: pkix-path: RFC 4518 NFKC + Unicode case fold for non-ASCII DN AVAs
